Use case: scientific-educational. Create one approved classroom illustration atlas with six images in exactly two rows and three columns on true transparent alpha. The invisible regular grid is only for cutting, with at least 14% fully clear margins around every cell. No labels, numerals, handwriting, grid lines, background cards, ground shadows or logos. For first graders, depict three real-looking original organizers, each in two clearly different orthographic views. The objects and visible contents must match exactly in the same column. Style: fine paper texture, matte gouache, simple clean cut-paper contours, deep pine, warm cream, apricot accents. Large clear visual parts, clear alpha between assets.
R1C1: Strict overhead looking straight into one upright open dark teal three-pocket school backpack, its wide main cavity open and a thin orange art album resting flat inside. A separate small zipped front compartment has one orange ribbon roll and flat violet eraser. A pale blue upright bottle with a gold cap is in the visible outer side mesh pocket. Exaggerate the distinction of these three storage places while preserving realistic bag construction. No other objects.
R2C1: Strict low side/front elevation of exactly that same dark teal backpack, same silhouette, same handles and pockets. Bag is upright on a flat base. The same upright pale blue capped bottle is half-enclosed in the side mesh pocket facing us; make the mesh texture and gold cap clear. Main opening is visible above, with the matching thin orange album in its interior if visible, no loose objects.
R1C2: Strict overhead one pale yellow rectangular toy storage box with a fully seated transparent lid, so both side-by-side inserts below it are visible. Left a small ochre insert with a few foam toy pieces, right a little blue box with a few differently shaped foam pieces, one thin muted teal hinge detail. Lid has no giant glare. Exactly the same box and objects as R2C2.
R2C2: Strict low front/side view of exactly that pale yellow box. Its same clear lid lies flat, fully closed, even at both edges. Show the same thin teal hinge and only the same contents if naturally visible through the lid. No gap, no lifted corner, no stacked extra object.
R1C3: Strict overhead view of one low coral organizer tray, clearly visible straight fixed divider making one long compartment and one short compartment. One unmarked teal ruler lies flat in the long bay. One cream block and one blue block sit in the short bay. Same tray, same fixed contents and colors as R2C3.
R2C3: Strict low side elevation of that same coral tray. Show the low rim and the unmarked teal ruler plus the same cream and blue blocks beneath the lip through a small translucent front panel, so the depth can be understood. Keep the divider in the same place and no objects outside. All edges safely rounded.
